name: loop-boundary
description: Compacts the main conversation to a near-clear at each /loop /auto iteration boundary (a turn ending with an iteration outcome line), with one ledger row per boundary

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Compact at iteration boundaries. Off changes nothing and writes no ledger.

loop_prefixes.title: Loop prompt prefixes
loop_prefixes.description: Comma-separated prefixes of the loop prompts whose iteration boundaries compact (the text after /loop and its interval).

min_context_percent.title: Minimum context percent
min_context_percent.description: Below this context fill a boundary is logged but not compacted. 0 compacts at every boundary.

ledger.title: Write ledger
ledger.description: Append one JSONL row per boundary and per passed-through looping turn to tmp/loop-boundary-<session>.jsonl under the session root.
